notes: DiscoFlate v3.85.0 — 🃏 Cards size themselves to their content. The poll/competition/bonus-round card divided its fixed height by the row count, so every entrant made the text smaller: at six rows a 16px glyph was being drawn inside a 13px bar, i.e. unreadable exactly when it had something to say. Height is now a MINIMUM — text size is fixed, rows keep a legible height, and the card grows. Near the bottom of the frame it grows UPWARD from its configured bottom edge instead of running off. Long names WRAP instead of being cut at 26 characters, and past Max rows (default 8, now a setting) it says “+N more” rather than silently dropping entrants. 🎚 Panel sliders also survive a nudge: the properties panel rebuilds itself on every change, which threw away the control mid-interaction so an arrow key worked exactly once.
